messages:
Maria: Heads up — after yesterday's kernel-selection change we're seeing steady mem growth on kv-cache for long chat sessions (>10k tokens). Ops-bot fired an alert at ~14:02 :rotating_light:
Ops-bot: alert kvcache_mem_growth_five_min firing for node pool-3 (region-us-west)
Sean: I can repro locally with the long-context harness. Mem climbs ~40MB per 1k tokens after ~8k tokens and doesn't fully reclaim when sessions end.
Jin: are evictions happening? eviction counters stable?
Maria: eviction_count for model-x is flat, residency drops a bit but not matching the retained delta. jemalloc show a lot of retained memory.
Oliver: sounds like external fragmentation — new kernel path might be allocating many small KV fragments that linger.
Sean: grabbed a pprof heap: https://profiler.internal/pprof/210987-snapshot (large diff after kernel swap)
Jin: can we get jemalloc stats from a repro run? command we used: `malloc_conf=background_thread:yes,metadata_thp:never jeprof --text /path/to/binary heap > heap.txt`
Maria: quick jemalloc excerpt from the box:
```
allocated: 1.2G
active: 1.15G
metadata: 120M
mapped: 1.4G
retained: 900M
```
Sean: retained/resident gap is worrying. eviction counters don't explain it. Could be many small mmaps or fragmentation inside arenas.
Oliver: kernel's new vectorized kernel selection path changed allocation cadence for KV shards — fewer but smaller allocations per fragment which hurts coalescing.
Jin: propose we add metrics to quantify this instead of guessing:
- `kv_cache_retained_bytes` (gauge)
- `kv_cache_resident_bytes` (gauge)
- `kv_cache_fragmentation_ratio = kv_cache_retained_bytes / kv_cache_resident_bytes` (derived)
- `kv_cache_accesses_total` (counter)
- `kv_cache_hits_total` (counter)
- `kv_cache_reuse_rate = kv_cache_hits_total / kv_cache_accesses_total` (derived)
- `kv_cache_evictions_total{reason}` (counter with reason label)
Maria: +1. Also add a sampled jemalloc retention gauge per-node every 30s to avoid noise.
Sean: For dashboard queries (PromQL):
```
sum by(model) (kv_cache_retained_bytes) / sum by(model) (kv_cache_resident_bytes)
sum by(model) (rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
sum by(model) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by(model) (rate(kv_cache_accesses_total[5m]))
```
Jin: and a per-session tail metric: 95th residency per session length bucket -> use a histogram on `kv_cache_residency_seconds_bucket` or per-token residency histogram. Example: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(kv_cache_residency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))`
Oliver: dashboard panels I want to add:
- Fragmentation ratio (7d) with alert if >0.6 for 10m
- 95th residency by model & session_length bucket
- Eviction reasons stacked by model (OOM vs TTL vs manual compaction)
- Reuse rate trend vs kernel-release tag (so we can correlate regressions)
Maria: mitigation options: revert kernel path (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1234) OR add aggressive compaction hook that runs after any session >8k tokens.
Sean: I'll prototype a compaction hook that triggers on session end for long sessions. Might call `kv_cache.compact_shards()` and sleep small, then measure reclaimed bytes.
Jin: I'll own the jemalloc collection + add `kv_cache_retained_bytes` export (low overhead sampling).
Oliver: I'll wire up dashboard panels and an alerting story in the dashboard repo.
Maria: Also let's track an eviction sampling counter to capture ephemeral page churn (sample gauge every 30s, low overhead).
Ops-bot: created issue INF-452: Track kv cache fragmentation & reuse metrics -> https://issues.internal/INF-452
Sean: will post prototype numbers and the compaction microbench here once ready.
Jin: started a small PR to export retained/resident: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/1240
Oliver: thanks — ping me when PRs land and I'll add panels.
Maria: great triage, team. primary owners: Oliver (dashboards), Jin (jemalloc/metrics), Sean (compaction prototype).
Maria: thanks all :thumbsup:
